The studio

Bit, and Baum.

Bit for software. Baum, German for tree, for the shape: many branches from one trunk. The trunk is what lets a small group ship like a large one — and what lets the next person start in the middle rather than at the beginning.

Build with us → See the work

What bitbaum is

Bitbaum is a product studio building AI-native software. OrangeCat, Loki and Solon are public beta products. Other projects are labelled on the work catalogue by what can be verified: pilot, in development, concept, or not built.

Why the stack is what it is

OrangeCat is the economic product, with payment links and Bitcoin settlement. Loki is the engineering control plane for dispatching work to agents, following sessions and reviewing changes. Solon is the governance product: proposals, one-click votes under rules a group chose, and a public record — in beta, with its governance agent being built alongside the first pilot groups.

How the work gets done

The studio publishes 10 MIT-licensed packages for specific jobs: model routing, email, content, forms, rate limits, lists, threads and more. They are not all used by every product. Each package profile links to its source, current version and apps that list it as a dependency. Agents can do implementation work in Loki; people set the goals, review changes and remain responsible for what ships.

What is true

The project list and package adopters come from public registers; stage descriptions and short summaries are editorial and are kept here for review. The work catalogue distinguishes projects built for real organisations from demos and things that are not built.

Open by construction

The shared packages are MIT-licensed. Work built for someone else stays theirs. Contributor terms live in bitbaum/.github. The origin register tracks 48 repositories, of which 44 have a Software Heritage snapshot; the earliest recorded proof is anchored at Bitcoin block 966918.

Numbers, in the open

Fleet's 2026-09-25 readings report 2 GitHub stars and 11,138 package downloads over 30 days (including our own CI installs). The same dated register reports CHF 0 monthly client revenue. These are readings, not forecasts; the source and date are linked.
